server: Single physical A100 6, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct BF16, 32768 context, 256 token steps, 8 slots, cold prefix, same pinned experimental 32K binary, fresh page then fixed-tile
design: 2x2. Both attention modes run a whole-corpus prompt and the same BM25-selected prompt for each of 24 natural-language lookup queries on independent seeded synthetic report corpora. Three sizes, balanced single and paired findings, source positions varied, same project decoys, no IDs in queries. Reverse case order for fixed-tile and alternate corpus strategy order by case.
intervention: BM25 scores the actual query text against authorized report text and selects at most eight complete passages in source order. The ranker does not receive answer or source IDs. Same question, instructions, max tokens, greedy sampling, streaming, and SSE token witness both ways. Eligibility is evidence lookup; whole-corpus extrema and counts require the full input.
accuracy: Natural stop with every expected source bound to the correct amount in the final text, no omitted, extra or duplicate source IDs. Record missing values/sources and whether relevant original passages were present in the final context. Source values are labeled independently of the ranker and model.
latency: Nearest-rank p95 over all 24 responses including incorrect responses, from before evidence selection/formatting to SSE DONE. Report prompt and generated token lengths, first and last visible content, and ranking time. Matching native prompt ID hash and no prefix credit between modes per strategy.
diagnostics_excluded_from_p95: Reproduce 24K repeated-word recall and 25K duplicate/omitted citation with original prompts, then keep the same question and supply its short supporting context. Gold-context diagnostic is explicitly separate from query-ranked cases. Compare earlier independent SDPA trace for 25K citation repetition.
judge: Improvement requires higher paired exact-answer count without removing any source passage needed by the workload; compare fixed-tile vs page separately at the same prompt preparation. Scope any result to the registered synthetic query family and one GPU. Legacy diagnostics and any newly incorrect cases reported separately.
